title: ProfileExchange
description: Firestore document schema for the `users/{uid}/exchanges` subcollection. The document id is the other attendee's Firebase Auth uid.

origin.description: 'scan' = the owner scanned the other attendee's QR code. 'mirror' = written by the onDocumentCreated trigger for the other attendee.

token.description: Present only until the trigger verifies a 'scan' write and clears it.
